# SAD Cycling

> A charity cycling expedition raising money for Great Ormond Street Hospital.

SAD Cycling is an annual long-distance charity cycling event organised by five riders — Stefano, Aurelio, Domenico (Mimmo), Julien, and Frezz — who undertake a multi-day cycling expedition every May in aid of Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity (registered charity number 235825).

## 2026 Edition: Marseille to Genoa

- Route: Marseille, France → Genoa, Italy (French and Italian Riviera)
- Dates: Wednesday 20 May – Saturday 23 May 2026
- Total distance: 437 km
- Total elevation: 4,377 m

### Daily stages

- Day 1 (20 May): Marseille → Saint-Raphaël — 162 km, 1,479 m elevation
- Day 2 (21 May): Saint-Raphaël → Nice — 72 km, 643 m elevation
- Day 3 (22 May): Nice → Alassio — 106.2 km, 1,429 m elevation (crosses into Italy via Monaco, Menton, San Remo)
- Day 4 (23 May): Alassio → Genoa — 97.1 km, 826 m elevation

## Charity

All funds raised go to Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity (GOSH), which supports one of the world's leading children's hospitals in London.

Donate: https://sadcycling.com/#charity

## Past Editions

- 2024: London to Paris
- 2025: London to Amsterdam (nearly 500 km)

## The Riders

- Stefano ("The Hedonist")
- Aurelio ("The Phoenix")
- Domenico / Mimmo ("The Captain")
- Julien ("The Two Mains King")
- Frezz ("The Ride Jockey")

## Live Tracking

The ride can be followed live via Wahoo GPS during the event.
